meta.name: deck-tech-sharing
meta.description: GitHub-dark + JetBrains Mono + 终端代码块, 含 agenda + Q&A

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用代码风格制作技术分享幻灯片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用幻灯片做技术分享，想要代码风格排版
copy.tagline_en: Create tech-sharing slides with code-style layout
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often make slides for tech sharing and want a code-style layout

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按这套模板产出技术分享用的幻灯片:封面(议题、讲者、handle)、议程页、含代码块与关键观点的正文页、Demo 页和 Q&A 页,配色为 GitHub-dark,字体为 JetBrains Mono。
howto.when: 当你要做工程内部分享或会议 talk 的幻灯片时,它会按这套模板接管排版与页面结构。

say.text: 帮我做一份技术分享的 deck,主题是单元测试实践
say.note: 产出封面、议程、正文、Demo、Q&A 页

say.text: 加一页议程页,列三个议题
把这段终端演示放到 Demo 页上

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude produces a tech-sharing slide deck from this template: cover (topic, speaker, handle), agenda page, body pages with code blocks and key points, a demo page, and a Q&A page, using GitHub-dark colors and JetBrains Mono.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need slides for an internal engineering sharing session or a conference talk; it then applies this template's layout and pages.

say_en.text: Make a tech sharing deck on unit testing practices
say_en.note: Produces cover, agenda, body, demo, Q&A pages

say_en.text: Add an agenda page listing three topics
Put this terminal demo on the demo page
say_en.note: Creates a demo page with the terminal shot
